mainEntity.name: How long does stair repair typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of stair repair varies significantly based on the extent of the damage, the type of materials involved, and the complexity of the staircase. Minor repairs, such as tightening a few loose treads, might take a few hours, while extensive structural repairs or the replacement of multiple components could span several days. A detailed assessment during the initial consultation helps us provide a more accurate timeline for your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stair repair duration depends on damage extent and complexity, ranging from hours for minor fixes to several days for extensive structural work, with a precise timeline provided after assessment.
